name: Hot Potato Salad
description: A warm potato salad dressed with a tangy vinegar-based sauce.

recipeInstructions.text: In a saucepan, combine the white vinegar, flour, and water. Heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens.
Add the butter, salt, pepper, and sugar to the vinegar mixture. Bring to a boil.
Pour the hot dressing over the sliced potatoes.

keywords: hot potato salad, vinegar dressing, warm salad

_similar.name: Sliced Bean Salad
_similar.description: A tangy and sweet pickled bean salad made with green or yellow beans, perfect for serving with onion and cream.

recipeInstructions.text: Slice the beans and cook until tender enough to pierce with a fork.
Drain the cooked beans and pack them into jars.
In a saucepan, bring the sugar, water, vinegar, and salt to a boil to make the syrup.
Pour the hot syrup over the beans in the jars.
To serve, pour off the liquid and add chopped onion and cream.

_similar.keywords: pickled bean salad, sweet and tangy, preserved beans

_similar.name: Sweet Potato Casserole
_similar.description: A classic sweet potato casserole with a crunchy pecan topping.

recipeInstructions.text: Peel, cut up, and boil the sweet potatoes until tender. Mash to make 3 cups.
Stir in the beaten eggs, melted butter, evaporated milk, and vanilla into the mashed sweet potatoes. Mix well.
Pour the sweet potato mixture into a baking dish.
Prepare the topping by mixing together the pecans, brown sugar, flour, and melted butter until crumbly.
Sprinkle the topping evenly over the sweet potato mixture.
Bake at 350 °F for 40 minutes.

_similar.keywords: sweet potato casserole, pecan topping, holiday side dish

_similar.name: Cream of Potato Soup
_similar.description: A rich and creamy potato soup enhanced with Campbell's soup base, leeks, and mushrooms, topped with shredded cheddar cheese.
recipeIngredient: Water or milk (as needed for consistency)

recipeInstructions.text: In a large pot, combine all ingredients except cheese.
Bring to a boil, stirring often, then simmer for 2 to 3 hours, adding more liquid if necessary.
Add shredded cheddar cheese during the last 30 minutes of simmering.

_similar.keywords: cream of potato soup, cheesy soup, slow-cooked soup

_similar.name: Strawberry Tossed Salad
_similar.description: A fresh and fruity salad with mixed greens, strawberries, and a sweet vinaigrette.
recipeIngredient: 4 cups torn Bibb or Boston lettuce
1 cup (4 oz) shredded Monterey Jack cheese
½ cup slivered almonds, toasted or coated with sugar
¼ cup cider or red wine vinegar

recipeInstructions.text: Combine the first 7 ingredients (oil, sugar, vinegar, garlic, salt, paprika, and white pepper) in a jar with a tight-fitting lid and shake well to make the dressing.
Just before serving, toss salad greens, strawberries, cheese, and almonds in a large salad bowl.
Drizzle with the prepared dressing and toss to coat.

_similar.keywords: strawberry salad, fruit salad, sweet salad dressing

_similar.name: Sliced Baked Potatoes
_similar.description: A simple yet elegant baked potato dish featuring thinly sliced potatoes topped with melted cheddar and Parmesan cheese, and fresh herbs.
recipeIngredient: 2-3 Tbsp fresh chopped herbs (such as parsley, chives, thyme, or sage)

recipeInstructions.text: Scrub and rinse the potatoes.
Cut the potatoes crosswise into thin slices, but not all the way through. Use the handle of a wooden spoon on either side of the potato to guide the knife.
Place the potatoes on a baking sheet and fan them slightly.
Drizzle the potatoes with melted butter and sprinkle with fresh herbs.
Bake at 425°F for about 50 minutes.
Sprinkle with cheddar and Parmesan cheese and return to the oven until the cheese is lightly browned and the potatoes are soft inside.

_similar.keywords: baked potatoes, sliced potatoes, cheesy potatoes, herbed potatoes
